# Rolling-origin evaluation, 5 folds, seed 1 (generated by scripts/rolling_report.py)

Rules fixed in `results/rolling/PREREGISTRATION.md` (commit `0d36807`) before training. **One seed per fold.** Neural models use their Phase 3 selected condition; ensemble = top-2 on each fold's validation block. Pooled = the five test blocks concatenated. DM vs persistence (HLN, Newey–West lag h − 1); p with sign (− = lower loss than persistence). Verdict on pooled windows: p < 0.05 with the sign; Holm over the 36 pooled neural/ensemble tests per loss.

## Pooled verdicts: beats persistence (absolute loss)

- **None.**
